svg.title: What happened to the 109 flagged units
svg.desc: Stacked bar chart. For each of three model tiers, the flagged claim units split into dropped or rewritten, repeated unchanged and still unsupported, and repeated unchanged and now grounded, the last of which is zero on every tier.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What happened to the 109 flagged units

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each flagged unit was returned to the model with the expanded context and an instruction

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to support it or leave it out. Not one was rescued by the fetched context, on any tier.
